5.title: Reporting & Exit Meeting

6.title: Audit Completed

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to frequently asked questions

q1.question: How do I change my password?
q1.answer: Go to Settings > Change Password. Enter your current password, then create a new password adhering to the security guidelines.

q2.question: How do I create a new risk profile?
q2.answer: Navigate to Risk Management > Risk Profiles and click on the 'Add New Profile' button. Fill in the required fields including risk name, category, impact level, and probability.

q3.question: Can I export audit reports to PDF?
q3.answer: Yes, you can export any audit report to PDF. Open the report you want to export and click on the 'Export' button in the top right corner, then select PDF format.

q4.question: How do I change the application language?
q4.answer: You can change the language from the Settings > Language & Region section. Currently, we support English and Bahasa Indonesia with instant dynamic updates.

q5.question: What are the different risk levels?
q5.answer: Risk levels are calculated based on impact and probability scores: Low (1-3), Low to Moderate (4-6), Moderate (7-9), Moderate to High (10-12), and High (13-15).

aiHome.isolationDescription: Detect banking operational anomalies in funding, lending, treasury, KYC, and IT controls without static rules to mitigate fraud early.
aiHome.nlpDescription: Analyze sentiment and automatically classify audit working-paper findings into standard risk categories.
aiHome.forecastDescription: Forecast next-quarter audit KPIs with upper and lower confidence bounds and proactive improvement recommendations.
